messages:
jnash: Kicking off a short thread to align on multi-region routing + tenant isolation priorities for the roadmap. We need concrete launch criteria, a small customer pilot plan, and a risk/migration checklist for sales/legal. Keeping this tight.
lina: high level thumbs up. can we prioritize the asks that unblock Dedicated and Private customers first? those tend to have the hardest compliance asks.
devin: +1. also need clarity on enforcement mode: advisory (logs only) vs opt-in soft-routes vs enforced slices. each has different infra & contract implications.
jnash: thinking three tracks: 1) Advisory/telemetry (Q2): policy DSL + observability, no traffic change. 2) Soft routing (Q3): route-by-policy + affinity, traffic shift gradual. 3) Slices (Q4+): infra-isolated lanes for top customers.
michelle: for product, please add specific stop conditions we can measure. e.g., p99 increase > 30ms for user traffic, error rate spike > 0.1%, or quality regression on eval set > 5%.
devin: propose rollout steps for soft routing: deploy policy -> shadow for 48h -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> full. auto-rollback if any stop condition tripped for 10m.
lina: contract note: customers asking for a "migration window" of 6 weeks where they can opt-out without penalty during rollout. we need legal to vet that.
jnash: good call. also a cost floor: slices require a committed seat or monthly minimum. we should publish a sample cost calc for sales.
michelle: telemetry checklist: route-level token/cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rates, synthetic probe failure, eval-quality delta. make data available in Console per-route.
devin: sample policy DSL (draft):
```yaml
policy_id: reg-compliance-1
match: region == "eu" and tenant.tier == "enterprise"
action:
  target: slice-eu-1
  mode: soft-redirect # options: observe | soft-redirect | enforce
  canary: true
  canary_steps: ["shadow", "5%", "25%"]
fallback: shared-pool
stop_conditions:
  latency_p99_ms: 30
  error_rate_pct: 0.1
  quality_drop_pct: 5
```
michelle: that DSL looks helpful. please make sure 'mode' is explicit so engineers don't accidentally enforce.
jnash: owners: product (michelle) owns launch criteria & customer comms; eng-platform (devin) owns policy runtime and rollout automation; eng-sre owns runbooks & synthetic probes; finance owns slice costing. ops-bot: adding a follow-up meeting at 1746004200.
ops-bot: follow-up scheduled: 1746004200 (invite sent).
lina: need a migration risk matrix in the spec: customer complexity (api usage patterns), data residency, traffic volume, and dependency surface (functions, tools).
devin: action items: I'll draft a minimal policy DSL PR and a rollout automation prototype. target: PR by EOD Tuesday.
michelle: I'll surface legal / sales contract language and sample cost sheet.
jnash: thanks. if no objections I'll collapse this into a short RFC and share a doc link in this channel within 48h. react with :thumbsup: if aligned.
